name: toggle-28
description: A single annual billing toggle that applies a discount to the displayed price.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Toggle } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle" export default function AnnualBillingToggle() { const [annual, setAnnual] = React.useState(false) const price = annual ? 16 : 20 return (
Team plan Pay yearly -20%

{"$" + price} / seat / month

{annual ? "Billed $192 per seat each year." : "Billed monthly. Cancel anytime."}

) }
